title: Pure Springans
summary: Springans cards with Great Sand Sea - Gold Golgonda, Gigantic "Champion" Sargas and generic staples. The page's Fallen of Albaz, Branded and Therion alliances are left out, so the old Springans Kitt, which searches Branded cards, stays out too. Every Springans main-deck monster attaches itself to a Springans Xyz from the hand, field or GY, and Golgonda summons a Springans Xyz straight from the Extra Deck. The Burst Protocol cards lead: Gung-Ho! Springans! summons Captain Sargas and pulls more Springans from the Deck, and Tri-Brigade Springans Kitt summons itself next to a Springans and revives one when it goes to the GY.

Attaches itself; banishes with another Springans to search any Springans card.
